home.emptyBefore: The boutique catalog is being prepared. Check back soon, or

product.unavailable: This product is no longer available.

cart.title: Your bag

checkout.title: Request your order
checkout.intro: Enter your phone number twice to confirm it. We will contact you on WhatsApp or by phone to confirm the order. Payment is not taken on this site.
checkout.name: Name
checkout.errPhoneMatch: The two phone numbers do not match. Please make sure they are identical.
checkout.delivery: I need delivery to my address
checkout.errAddress: Please add your address for delivery.
checkout.errGeneric: We could not save your order. Please try again later.
checkout.errStatus: Database is not migrated. Please run the SQL files in supabase/migrations.
checkout.errPhone: Please enter a valid phone number.
checkout.errItems: Could not send the cart contents.

orderSuccess.title: Thank you
orderSuccess.enterPhone: To see your order status, enter the same phone number you used at checkout.
orderSuccess.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid phone number.
orderSuccess.notFound: We could not find an order for this number and reference. Check both and try again.
orderSuccess.missingId: No order reference in the link. Open the link from the confirmation page.
orderSuccess.body: Our team will contact you to confirm. Keep this page open — when we confirm the order, you will see a confirmation message here.
orderSuccess.confirmedBody: Your order has been confirmed. We will follow up about pickup or delivery.
orderSuccess.waFallback: I placed a request on Lozan. Reference: {id}

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist, or it may have moved.

login.title: Admin
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage products and orders.
login.errTimeout: This is taking too long. Check the browser console (F12) → Network, your .env Supabase URL/key, and that the project is online.
login.errGeneric: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password, or that Supabase is configured.
login.errNotAdmin: This account is not in the “admins” list yet. In Supabase → Table editor → public.admins, add a row with id exactly: {id} (same as Auth → Users for this email), then try again.
login.errCouldNotConfirm: Could not confirm admin access. Try again in a moment.

products.title: Products
products.empty: No products yet. Add your first one.
products.confirmDelete: Delete this product? This cannot be undone.
products.errNoPermission: You don’t have permission to edit/delete products. Make sure your account UUID is in public.admins (it must match the auth user id), then sign out and back in.
products.errStorageDelete: Product was deleted but its images stayed in Storage: {msg} (run supabase/storage-policies.sql)

orders.title: Orders
orders.empty: No customer requests yet. They’ll appear when someone checks out.
orders.pickup: Pick-up or details to be confirmed
orders.newOrderBody: A customer just submitted a request. Open the admin to review it.
orders.waText: Hello! We’re following up on Lozan order #{idRef}.

form.offerPriceHint: Optional. When set and lower than the regular price, customers see this as the active price with the regular price crossed out.
form.stockInStockHint: Ready to sell — customers can add to bag.
form.stockUnavailableHint: Shown at the end of the shop as “Not available”. Customers can view the dress but cannot order.
form.stockBackorderHint: Also shown as “Not available” in the shop. On the product page, customers can order anyway (~10 days from supplier).
form.colorsHint: Pick from the preset palette or use a custom color. You can edit the Arabic and English names after picking.
form.sizesHint: Add the European sizes you have for this dress. Customers must pick one when ordering.
form.imagesHint: Upload one or more photos. Mark one as the cover (shop listing). Large files are compressed automatically.
form.filesHint: JPG or PNG. New files upload on Save.
form.errOfferTooHigh: Offer price must be lower than the regular price.
form.errMissingFile: Missing file for a new image preview. Try re-uploading.
form.errTimeout: Request timed out. Check: (1) Supabase URL and API key in .env, (2) Storage bucket and policies, (3) run SQL migrations so public.products exists.
form.errMissingTable: The database table is missing or not published. In Supabase → SQL, run all files in supabase/migrations in order, then try again.
form.errMissingColumn: The database column “{col}” is missing. Open Supabase → SQL editor, run the latest file in supabase/migrations (e.g. 00007_offer_price.sql), then run: notify pgrst, 'reload schema'; — and try saving again. Detail: {msg}
form.errStorage: {msg} Create a public bucket (e.g. product-images) and storage policies, or check VUE_APP_SUPABASE_STORAGE_BUCKET.
form.errNoPermission: Save went through but no row was changed in the database. Most likely this account is not registered as an admin. Add your account UUID to public.admins, then sign out and back in.
form.errGeneric: Save failed. Check Supabase, Storage policies, and try again.
